issue_context.title: IIFE in nested element does not work
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug Calling IIFE inside of nested element does not work, as opposed to top level element. ```svelte 'red')()}>span (red) ^ get class="red" rendered
'red')()}>div > span (red) ^ span does not have class attribute
``` This worked in 5.1.17, but regressed in 5.2.0. ### Reproduction https://svelte.dev/playground/8d35c2574e7a4a3bbd15a7578623535c?version=5.2.0 https://svelte.dev/playground/8d35c2574e7a4a3bbd15a7578623535c?version=5.1.17 ### Logs _No response_ ### System Info ```shell Svelte Playground 5.2.0 (or 5.1.17) ``` ### Severity blocking an upgrade

review_comments: I think this is good, just for the sake of it, can we check wherever else we set `can_inline` to false to see if the subtree is actually marked dynamic?
I added it to other places but didn't notice any differences. Which was odd, but this whole inline/dynamic system feels a bit wonky tbh.
Yeah i think we need to restructure this a bit to keep a single source of truth (but i think it will be difficult)
